pricing.note: the pricing model of a provider connected through an HTTP mapping, on a capability chip: Pricing · set by your provider

terms.0.note.message: ReputeCast can't read the terms of a provider connected through an HTTP mapping. Check its acceptable-use policy before routing Broadcasts to it.
terms.0.note.note: what the terms allow, on Routing, when a mapping says nothing about them

events.note: Sending providers › Adapters: events come back through webhooks the mapping reads

eventsNone.note: Sending providers › Adapters: a mapping without webhooks

domainSetup.note: Sending providers › Adapters: the domain's DNS records are added by hand

suppressionMode.note: Sending providers › Adapters: suppressions are kept in ReputeCast only

field.api_key.label: API key

field.api_key.help.message: Read by the mapping's templates as '{{ secrets.api_key }}'.
field.api_key.help.note: {{ secrets.api_key }} is template code: keep it as it is

field.webhook_signing_key.label: Webhook signing secret
field.webhook_signing_key.help: When the provider signs webhooks with a secret of its own. Without it, ReputeCast's webhook secret for this provider is used.

mapping.bodyNotJson.message: The body template isn't valid JSON once its '{{ }}' fields are filled in.
mapping.bodyNotJson.note: a problem of the Generic HTTP adapter form; {{ }} is template code

mapping.messageIdTwice: Read the message id from the response body or from a header, not both.

mapping.headerName.message: {name} is not a valid header name.
mapping.headerName.note: name: the header's name, in quotes

mapping.headerReserved.message: {name} is set by ReputeCast and can't be mapped.

mapping.url: Enter an https:// URL, for example https://api.example-esp.com/v1/messages.

mapping.urlHost.message: The host must be written out; '{{ }}' fields may only appear in the path and query.

mapping.urlPlainHttp: Use https://; plain http:// is only allowed for a local test server.

mapping.webhookMapping.note: status and jsonpath are the setting's values

mapping.encoding.note: hex and base64 are the setting's values

mapping.payloadBody.note: {body} is a placeholder of the setting: keep it as it is

mapping.payloadTimestamp.message: Name the timestamp header the '{timestamp}' comes from.
mapping.payloadTimestamp.note: {timestamp} is a placeholder of the setting: keep it as it is

mapping.tokenHeader: Name the header that carries the secret.

mapping.auth.message: Use hmac, standard, basic, header or none.

mapping.typePath.message: Enter the JSONPath of the event type, for example $.event.

mapping.typeMapsTo.message: {from} maps to {to}; use delivered, deferred, hard_bounce, soft_bounce, bounce, complaint, rejected, open, click, unsubscribe or ignore.
mapping.typeMapsTo.note: from: the provider's event type; to: what the mapping says; the list is the values to use
